capabilities: upload pasted clipboard images to an AWS S3 bucket
insert S3 links into the note at paste time
upload dragged media files including video, audio and PDFs
override upload behavior per note with YAML frontmatter
copy uploads to a local folder instead of S3
extras: Setup requires manual bucket configuration: a world-readable bucket policy, a CORS policy, and an IAM user with write access. The plugin is ad-supported and the README asks users to report bugs since it is still in development.
problem: Pasting images into Obsidian saves them locally, so sharing or viewing them elsewhere usually means relying on a third-party host such as imgur.

relations.evidence: the following Obsidian plugins: - Obsidian Image Uploader

requires.name: AWS account with an IAM user and S3 bucket

summary: Uploads pasted or dragged images and media to your own AWS S3 bucket and inserts links to them in notes.
